Monday, October 05, 2026

Open Apache-2.0 weights carried the day, and with dedicated deciders landing at both 2B and 26B, agent judgment is splitting off into its own model class — routing calls no longer need to burn frontier tokens.

━━━ OPEN FRONTIER 🔓
JEV 27B VL — A mid-size vision-language model for builders who need image understanding inside an open stack, with no API dependency. 27B total params · Apache-2.0 · Released Oct 3. 📦 Open weights · HF. → Source

OrcaSAQ-2 27B — OrcaRouter's second SAQ generation ships as a general-purpose text generator straight to open weights. 27B total params · Apache-2.0 · Released Oct 2. 📦 Open weights · HF. → Source

━━━ SPECIALIZED 🎯
GEV 26B Decide — A decision specialist that classifies instead of generating — judgment calls without a full LLM pass. 26B total params · Apache-2.0 · Decision Index suite 0.2 (edition 0.2.1): 62.48 · Released Oct 3. 📦 Open weights · HF. → Source

━━━ LOCAL 🏠
Strands Decider 2B — An agent decider shrunk to 2B so routing calls run on your own hardware, not a metered API. 2B total params · Apache-2.0 · JevBench public 0.7229 · boardgame 0.822 · contractnli 0.872 · Released Oct 1. 📦 Open weights · HF. → Source
